results.title: 9/11: Reunited
results.overview: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

results.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
results.overview: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

results.title: Lion
results.overview: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

results.title: Lanterns
results.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

results.title: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
results.overview: Tracing Charles Manson's rise as a cult leader, the 1969 murders, and his trial, using unreleased prison recordings, interviews, and archival footage.

results.title: MOURINHO
results.overview: This trophy-packed, insider-fuelled documentary charts José Mourinho's iconic rise as one of the world's top footballing managers of the most elite clubs.

results.title: Monsters of God
results.overview: Filmmaker Eric Goode follows his first love — reptiles — into the dark underworld of exotic animal smuggling. In this billion-dollar global network, everyone is chasing the ultimate prize, whether it be owning the rarest of species, claiming the biggest fortunes, or taking down the most elusive criminals. As he digs deeper, Goode uncovers a labyrinth of outlaw traffickers, bombastic collectors, and the dogged law enforcement agents on their tails.

results.title: The Shards
results.overview: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

results.title: Sterling Point
results.overview: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

results.title: Fightland
results.overview: A disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime syndicate he thinks betrayed him.

results.title: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
results.overview: Through bodycam footage, texts and interviews with loved ones, this documentary investigates the horrifying murder of four University of Idaho students.

results.title: Game Day Murders
results.overview: Veteran sportscaster Lindsay Czarniak explores the deadly intersection of sports and crime through six murder investigations involving athletes. Each episode blends a gripping whodunit with the culture surrounding the game.

results.title: Furious
results.overview: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

results.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
results.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

results.title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
results.overview: A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind.

results.title: Extreme Buyers Club
results.overview: Bold and fearless Texas real estate agent Noel Collier tackles the most unique home and property searches imaginable. Loud, hilarious, and authentic, she's built her reputation on one thing: finding extreme homes for extreme buyers.

results.title: The Hawk
results.overview: On the back nine of his career, golf legend Lonnie "The Hawk" Hawkins chases one final major — and drags everyone he loves into the chaos.

results.title: Ride or Die
results.overview: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

results.title: Lucky
results.overview: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

results.title: Murder 101
results.overview: Part teen drama, part masterclass, and part edge-of-your-seat crime investigation, follow a high school sociology class in rural Tennessee who help revive a decades-old case into a present-day hunt for a killer.

results.title: Little House on the Prairie
results.overview: The close-knit Ingalls family builds a new life on the Western frontier, where the joys of nature and the struggle for survival are deeply intertwined.

results.title: The Five Star Weekend
results.overview: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.

results.title: Elle
results.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

results.title: Mohabbati Rutt
results.overview: Mohabbati Rutt follows Bindri, who loses his parents in childhood and is raised by a caring neighbour, Aunt Shinder. Along with his inseparable friends Forman and Chiddhi, he shares a strong bond built on friendship, laughter, and dreams of marriage. As the three friends move through life together, the film celebrates friendship, love, emotions, and relationships.

results.title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
results.overview: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

results.title: The Doomies
results.overview: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

results.title: The American Experiment
results.overview: Life. Liberty. The pursuit of happiness. This sweeping historical documentary series traces how the ideals of America's founders gave rise to a nation.

results.title: Flatmates
results.overview: After being thrown out of their flat, Davy and Gavy begin living with Riya and Tarushi in the same apartment. As the four flatmates adjust to each other's habits, they face funny fights, messy situations, and daily problems. Their growing friendship slowly changes them from strangers into close friends before their journey together finally reaches an emotional ending.

results.title: Trade Up
results.overview: Finale celeb special! Thugesh & Vanshaj bring fun & feel-good trades ka dhamaka. Ek taraf masti, doosri taraf mission - Can they pull off a finale-worthy trade?

results.title: Pardhan
results.overview: Aman enters university hoping for a fresh start but soon finds himself caught in the intense world of student politics. As election campaigns heat up, friendships are tested, rivalries grow stronger, and ambitions take center stage. Amid the chaos, a mysterious criminal investigation unfolds, exposing dangerous secrets that threaten to change lives and the future of the campus forever.

results.title: I Will Find You
results.overview: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

results.title: Most Extreme Humans
results.overview: Explores the lives of people with extraordinary physical conditions, rare medical challenges, and remarkable transformations as they navigate everyday life, relationships, and the pursuit of their dreams.

results.title: Big Girls Wanted: Escaping Pearadise
results.overview: Pearadise promised safety and a utopia for plus‑size women. The sisterhood turns dark as allegations of assault and coercion spread among the women.

results.title: Every Year After
results.overview: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

results.title: Dragon Striker
results.overview: In a world where sports and magic combine, farm boy Key discovers his ultrapowerful natural talent and learns he could be the legendary Dragon Striker.

results.title: Cape Fear
results.overview: When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

results.title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
results.overview: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.
